title: Yonto type name
description: A short id for Yonto's own type (maccms-json), or anybody else's reverse-DNS name (io.github.someone.alist): lowercase RFC 1123 labels, letters and digits with hyphens only inside, two or more of them for reverse-DNS, and 253 characters at most in all.
$comment: The one grammar for a type name, $ref'd by the manifest's `handles` and the index's `ext.yontoType` so the two can never disagree. tools/plugin-cli/conformance/yonto-type-names.json holds the cases.
